# Step - diff_schema

`diff_schema` · category: [Schema](../../traversal/step_reference.md#schema)

Compares the stored schema with the given schema map: {changes, compatible}.

## Forms

```text
diff_schema(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.diff_schema(g.infer_schema())["compatible"]   // true
```
